Interface: input clk, rst_n; input req, input cancel, input finish; output busy, output accepted, output completed, output cancelled, output expired
Specification: A single outstanding request with a three-edge completion window. Async active-low rst_n clears all state and outputs. At each rising clk edge, clear accepted/completed/cancelled/expired pulses. If idle before the edge, req=1 accepts a request, sets busy=1 and remaining=3, pulses accepted. cancel/finish have no effect while idle, even on acceptance. If busy before the edge, ignore req. Priority is cancel, then finish, then deadline. cancel terminates with cancelled=1; else finish terminates with completed=1; else remaining=1 terminates with expired=1; otherwise decrement remaining. No replacement is accepted on any terminating edge. Thus after acceptance, the next three rising edges are the response window; finish or cancel at the third edge beats expiry. busy and pulses hold between edges; async reset dominates simultaneous events.
